messages:
Sarah M.: ok team — finalizing the social schedule for the 5/10 webinar + benchmark narrative. need X + LinkedIn copy, hero assets, and confirmation on inbound lead routing. can we close by EOD? :spiral_calendar:

Jamal R.: got it. i can draft short + long variants. short for X, long for LI. will include 2 CTAs (register / benchmark report).

Olivia G.: timezone check — webinar is 2025-05-10 10:00 PT, right? scheduling posts the day before and day-of morning. suggest 9am PT (day-of) + 11am PT (reminder thread) for X. LinkedIn: 11:30am PT day-of.

Violet (Design): sending hero assets in a sec. need final copy to pick the focal line. also confirm aspect ratios: X 1200x675 and LI 1200x627?

Ben S.: inbound leads from webinar signups should route to #sdr-inbound and create a ticket in Salesforce with utm_source=social&utm_campaign=webinar_may10. who owns the webhook?

Sarah M.: @Ben S. — SDR flow: yeah route to #sdr-inbound + SFDC capture. @eng-ops set webhook to push to /webhooks/salesforce/creates. tagging @Olivia G. for UTMs in post links.

Jamal R.: draft copies below — pick one or ask for tweaks.

---
X (short): "What if inference was predictable? Join our webinar 5/10 to see real latency & cost benchmarks + live Q&A. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=webinar_may10 #LLM #inference"

X (thread follow-up reminder): "Live in 1 hour — benchmark deep-dive + optimization tips for production LLMs. Last spots: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=webinar_may10"

LinkedIn (long): "Building LLM features? Join Redwood Inference on May 10 for a hands-on webinar: we’ll walk through latency and cost benchmarks from real customer workloads, deployment tradeoffs, and operational best practices. Bring your questions — live Q&A after the demo. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=webinar_may10"
---

Olivia G.: those look good. for OG/preview use the hero image named "webinar-hero-v3.png" (sent to #design-exports). Violet — please export with open graph metadata: og:title and og:description matching the LI line above.

Violet (Design): exported and uploaded: https://assets.redwood.ai/designs/webinar-hero-v3.png. added og tags in the export bundle. also provided square 1:1 thumbnail for LinkedIn carousel.

Ben S.: confirmed routing: i created a quick SFDC flow. Eng-ops, please wire the webhook to include these fields in the payload: email, name, utm_source, utm_campaign, webinar_slot. sample payload: ```{ "email": "${email}", "name": "${name}", "utm_source": "social", "utm_campaign": "webinar_may10" }```

Olivia G.: scheduling plan — can someone approve and run these commands? i’ll queue via our scheduler: 
/schedule post --channel X --when "2025-05-09T09:00:00-07:00" --content "[X short copy]" --image webinar-hero-v3.png --utm utm_source=social&utm_campaign=webinar_may10
/schedule post --channel LinkedIn --when "2025-05-10T11:30:00-07:00" --content "[LinkedIn long copy]" --image webinar-hero-v3.png --utm utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=webinar_may10

Sarah M.: approvals: @Jamal R. copy ✅, @Violet (Design) assets ✅, @Ben S. routing ✅. @Olivia G. please run the scheduler and paste the scheduled IDs here. :pray:

publish-bot: scheduled post created — id 508231 (X 2025-05-09T09:00:00-07:00) by Olivia G.

publish-bot: scheduled post created — id 508232 (LinkedIn 2025-05-10T11:30:00-07:00) by Olivia G.

Jamal R.: small ask — can we A/B the X headline? variant B: "Real benchmarks for LLM latency & cost — webinar 5/10. register now." will set up pin to measure CTR on the first hour.

Ben S.: suggest capturing a lead tag "webinar_may10_ab" for variant B so we can split in SFDC. done.

Sarah M.: awesome. final checklist: 1) assets uploaded (Violet) 2) copy locked (Jamal) 3) posts scheduled (Olivia) 4) inbound webhook wired (Ben) 5) tracking UTMs confirmed (Olivia) 6) monitor first-hour engagement & route hot leads to SDRs. I’ll own monitoring during the webinar. anyone wants handoff on monitoring?

Olivia G.: i can shadow monitoring first-hour. set me a calendar invite for 10:00-11:30 PT.

Violet (Design): minor note — if we need a 2nd hero for variant B, i can spin one in 30m.

Sarah M.: great. thanks everyone — closing thread. :tada:
